dedupe_keys.name: food price crowdsourcing africa fpca mobile app food prices from nigerian markets and farms 2021

description: This data set collects staple food prices reported by ordinary people through a mobile phone app at markets and farms in Nigeria, with weekly estimates cleaned for statistical use. The producers are the European Commission's Joint Research Centre, which ran the Food Price Crowdsourcing Africa project, with Gloria Solano Hermosilla, Fabio Micale, Julius Adewopo, Celso Jesús Gorrín González, Giuseppe Arbia and Vincenzo Nardelli. Coverage in the files is the states of Kano, Katsina, Kaduna and Lagos from late March to late November 2021, for maize, local and imported rice, beans, garri and soybean, at retail, wholesale and farm-gate stages. Raw submissions carry the product, price, packaging unit, price per kilogram, coordinates, local government area and market type, and the processed files give weekly state estimates after outlier removal and a post-sampling correction. The files are available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: volunteer reports vary in density and quality, units must be converted from local measures, and the pilot ran for one season. Simulation uses: near real-time monitoring of food market disruption, price transmission between farm and retail, and early warning inputs for food supply shocks. Related records: the WFP global food prices (data-wfp-global-food-prices) and FEWS NET data explorer (data-fews-net-data-explorer) give official market price series.
name: Food Price Crowdsourcing Africa (FPCA): mobile app food prices from Nigerian markets and farms (2021)
provider: European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC): Gloria Solano Hermosilla, Fabio Micale and colleagues, with Julius Adewopo, Celso Jesús Gorrín González, Giuseppe Arbia and Vincenzo Nardelli
schema_summary: step2.csv: one row per submitted price with volunteer and device ids, product, price type (retail, wholesale, farm gate), market type, latitude, longitude, state and LGA codes, submission time, packaging unit and conversion, observed price and price per kg, reporter role, distance to market, population density and outlier and cluster flags; step3 files: weekly aggregated and post-sampled price estimates by state and product
